//: Copy to config.json. Every key is optional; delete what you do not need.
//dataDir: Where issues live. Default: ~/solo-ops. Point it at a synced folder to work from two machines.
//notesDir: Any folder of Markdown: an Obsidian vault, a plain notes directory, an agent-ops store.
//notesInbox: Subfolder holding loose captures. Auto-detected: _Inbox, inbox, Inbox, '00 Inbox'.
//obsidianVault: Vault name. Set it and linked notes become obsidian:// deep links.
